title: Preserve worktree-local FetchContent cache across reconfigure
body: The command nice -n 10 cmake --build build/wsl -- -j8 triggered CMake regeneration and reset FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR to the shared home cache. Changing VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE only for the subsequent build did not invalidate the configured cache; an explicit VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/build/vixbase-fetchcontent-cache cmake --preset vixen-wsl configure was required before building. Make the worktree cache choice persist across regeneration and build invocations.

title: Make VIXEN CodegenTool bootstrap independent of host ICU
body: The first recipe_simd_check build failed before the generator ran with Couldn't find a valid ICU package installed. Setting DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 for the same scoped build made the check pass. Provision ICU or make the supported invariant mode part of the CMake CodegenTool route.

title: Keep WSL GPU loader paths complete in the documented runner
body: The login-shell GPU runner needed LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib:<worktree>/VIXEN/.windowing-deps/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu for the DZN and X11 runtime libraries to load together. Add the worktree X11 dependency directory from the selected checkout in the documented GPU launcher rather than requiring each lane to assemble this path.

title: Expose CodeGraph queries in disposable VIXEN worktrees
body: The required codegraph explore query had no index in this disposable worktree, so source discovery fell back to manual rg and git history. Provision an index or provide a read-only query route during worktree setup.

title: Provide an aggregate RenderGraph and SVO test build target
body: After the full build stopped at appflow_check, validating the requested suites required manually enumerating 24 separate RenderGraph and SVO executable targets. Add one supported target for building the complete RenderGraph plus SVO verification scope.

title: Select RenderGraph and SVO tests with stable CTest labels
body: After CMake reconfiguration, the RenderGraph test IDs moved from 43-1357 to 493-1807 and SVO moved from 1426-2167 to 1941-2682. I had to run ctest -N -V and parse executable paths to select the suite ranges. Give these suites stable labels or named selection groups.

title: Use the live runner capture directory in windowed CTest fixtures
body: The HUD and editor capture apps write PNGs under VIXEN/temp, while CTest launches their file-reading tests from build/wsl/libraries/RenderGraph/tests. Three HUD assertions initially failed on missing files until VIXEN_HUD_CAPTURE_DIR and VIXEN_EDITOR_CAPTURE_DIR were set to the absolute worktree VIXEN/temp path. Align fixture and CTest working directories or set the capture path as a test property.

title: Derive image layout in RenderTargetReadback
body: The editor capture target remains VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL after graph rendering, so the readback helper needed a caller-supplied currentLayout value and explicit restoration. Derive the last graph-owned layout or expose a graph render-target readback API so callers do not manually provide this synchronization hint.

title: Keep the runtime manifest out of the tracked global cache
body: Running the editor and main capture apps changed the tracked VIXEN/cache/global/manifest.txt file; I had to restore it after the runs to keep the lane clean. Place runtime cache manifests under a build or user cache directory rather than a tracked source path.

title: Pin RmlUi to a GCC 15 compatible upstream revision
body: The initial full build failed in the RmlUi 6.0 debugger's robin_hood.h because uint32_t and uint64_t were undeclared. Merging the RmlUi 6.3 dependency update fixed the compile and linked rmlui_debugger. Keep the selected dependency tag compiler-compatible in the VIXEN WSL preset.

title: Document the WSL binary directory and scoped target names
body: An initial cmake --build build/wsl from VIXEN/ looked under the wrong binary directory; the preset puts the build at ../build/wsl. The guessed target test_editor_toggle_undo_capture was also not registered; the windowed tests are built by test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture. Provide a worktree-aware helper or target map for these exact commands.
